PLAN "12-Week Postpartum Return Programme (C-Section, Home, Mat Only) — Summary"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "postpartum recovery, core restoration, progressive strength, and cardiovascular fitness"

PHASES
  PHASE "Phase 1: Gentle Movement & Mobility" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1-4:
      - 2x/week mobility/strength sessions: walking, cat_cow, pelvic_tilt, bird_dog, glute/shoulder/chest stretches, child_pose
      - 1x/week steady-state walking cardio, gradually increasing duration (15–23m main set)
      - Intensity: RPE 2–4, focus on healing, gentle movement, and mobility

  PHASE "Phase 2: Foundation, Core & Strength Reintroduction" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 5-8:
      - 2x/week strength/core sessions: walking, cat_cow, pelvic_tilt, bird_dog, glute_bridge, diaphragmatic_breathing, dead_bug (from week 7), gentle stretching
      - 1x/week steady-state walking cardio, increasing to 33m main set
      - Intensity: RPE 3–5, introduce glute/hip/core activation, progress reps/sets, add dead_bug and diaphragmatic_breathing for core

  PHASE "Phase 3: Progressive Strength, Core & Endurance" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 9-12:
      - 2x/week strength/core sessions: glute_bridge, step_up, push_up, dead_bug, plank, side_plank, pallof_press, walking warmup, stretching
      - 1x/week steady-state walking cardio, progressing to 45m main set, RPE 6–7
      - Intensity: RPE 6–9, higher sets/reps, longer holds, challenging core (plank, side_plank, pallof_press), strong finish by week 12

NUTRITION
  ENERGY:
    description "Maintenance calories plus 400-500 kcal/day for breastfeeding. Adjust for hunger, energy, and weight trends."
  PROTEIN:
    description "1.2–1.5g/kg bodyweight daily from high-quality sources."
  CARBOHYDRATES:
    description "Whole grains, fruits, starchy vegetables at each meal."
  FATS:
    description "Healthy fats daily (avocado, olive oil, nuts, seeds, fatty fish)."
  HYDRATION:
    description "At least 3L water daily. More if thirsty or urine is dark."
  MICRONUTRIENTS:
    description "Continue prenatal or postnatal multivitamin. Ensure calcium, vitamin D, iron, iodine, choline."
  MEAL STRUCTURE:
    description "3 main meals and 2–3 snacks per day. Protein and produce at each."
  FOODS TO LIMIT:
    description "Caffeine <300mg/day. Avoid high-mercury fish. Limit processed foods and added sugars."
  SPECIAL NOTES:
    description "Monitor baby's response to foods. Consult a registered dietitian for personalized support."

CARDIO
  description "Steady-state walking 1x/week, progressing from 15m to 45m. No HIIT or plyometrics until after week 12 and only if symptom-free and cleared by OB/PT."

CORE
  description "Phase 1: pelvic_tilt, bird_dog, diaphragmatic_breathing. Phase 2: add dead_bug. Phase 3: add plank, side_plank, pallof_press. Avoid crunches, sit_up, v_up, leg_raise until after week 12 and only if symptom-free."

STRENGTH
  description "Phase 1: bodyweight mobility and activation. Phase 2: add glute_bridge, increase reps/sets. Phase 3: add step_up, push_up, increase intensity and volume. All mat-based, no equipment required."

PROGRESSION
  description "Gradual increase in volume, intensity, and complexity. Focus on healing, core restoration, and building strength and endurance. Ready for higher intensity (including HIIT) after week 12 if fully symptom-free and cleared."

HIIT (high-intensity interval training) should **not** be introduced until at least 12 weeks postpartum, and only if:

- She has completed a progressive return to moderate-intensity steady-state cardio and strength work (as in this programme).
- She is symptom-free: no pelvic pain, no urinary incontinence, no heaviness/pressure, no doming/coning at the abdomen, and no unresolved diastasis recti or pelvic floor dysfunction.
- She has OB or pelvic floor PT clearance for higher-impact/intensity exercise.

Avoid jumping, running, or plyometrics until at least 16–24 weeks postpartum and only if fully symptom-free.
